verified_facts: PG40s3 updated 1 June 2026 and applies to England and Wales
legal boundary is an exact line but is rarely identified precisely on the ground or in conveyances
most registered titles show general boundaries
no standard tolerance measurement or ratio maps a general boundary to the exact legal boundary
determined boundary is the route for showing an exact boundary line in the register
determined-boundary measurement plans require measurements accurate to +/-10mm when measurements are used
title plans normally show general boundaries unless determined
title plan supports the register by graphically identifying general extent
INSPIRE download published 5 July 2026 and refreshes on the first Sunday monthly
INSPIRE data is indicative extent/position of registered freehold properties
INSPIRE files are GML grouped by local authority
a polygon on a local-authority boundary can appear in both authority files
quality_effect: Prevents treating HMLR general/INSPIRE geometry as an exact legal survey boundary; preserves current monthly provenance and duplicate handling.
